changelog:
DriveFight 0.20.29 — Online stars and safer respawns

- Stars now appear in every supported online arena. Grab one, turn rainbow, and ram opponents or breakable props. Scenery removal stays consistent when players reconnect.
- Respawns use checked landing positions and discard old movement packets that could pull cars back under the map.
- Clearer main-menu match information, larger round results/countdowns, safer camera shortcuts, and a working return to the main menu.
- Press Y to toggle your microphone; the HUD shows when it is on.
- Tower keeps eight automatic bots.

Everyone joining online needs this update: Mac, Windows and Linux server use protocol 15.

Online modes are Arena Battle and Soccer on the configured private host/Tailscale network. Jungle, CTF, Easy Practice and Training Survival remain offline. Structural walls/roads and Maple Street's merged parked-car decorations are not breakable. Windows is cross-built; interactive Windows gameplay and public non-Tailnet access remain unverified.

Free personal, noncommercial preview. Star music made with Suno. Clients are unsigned; installation steps: https://drivefight.vercel.app/
